Id1.text: The campus of the Acharya Institute of Technology is located at Soldevanahalli, Acharya Dr. Sarvapalli Radhakrishnan Road, Hessarghatta Main Road, Bangalore – 560090. The Institute was founded by Kempe Gowda I and the current director is Dr. G. P. Prabhukumar. Tennis is one of the sports offered. The status of Technical Campus was given to the Institute by All India Council for Technical Education, located in Mumbai.
